use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let seeds = 3000
let phi = (Math.sqrt(5.0D) + 1.0D) / 2.0D

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(-200.0D, -200.0D, 200.0D, 200.0D)
image.clear(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 255ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)

for i in 0::seeds do
    let n = cast double(i)
    let r = Math.pow(n, phi) / cast double(seeds)
    let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi * phi * n

    image.circle(
        r * Math.sin(angle), r * Math.cos(angle),
        5.0D * n / cast double(seeds))
od

write_line("{seeds} seeds, each turned the golden angle from the last")

image.write("sunflower.png")

image.show("sunflower.png")
